mainEntity.name: What permits are required to build an attached ADU in Alameda County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU in Alameda County requires various permits, typically including building, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical permits. Depending on the project's scope and location within Alameda County cities like Hayward or Fremont, additional permits such as zoning clearance or grading permits may also be necessary. Hometelligent assists clients in navigating these requirements, ensuring all necessary documentation is prepared and submitted for a smooth approval process.
